patch_description: Replace the over-parameterized pair-specific block with the strongest permutation-equivariant design from prior results. Sharing each rotation across all qubits reduces the circuit from 13 to 4 parameters per block and total parameters from 80 to 26, improving regularization and parameter efficiency. Complete-graph CZ entanglement aligns the ansatz with all 28 pairwise feature channels, while one controlled phase adds limited symmetry-breaking expressivity. The final shared RY layer converts accumulated feature-dependent phases into the mean-Z measurement basis. Prior metrics indicate this structure raises validation accuracy to about 0.96, lowers validation loss to about 0.23, and reduces the generalization gap.
